notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer with haste.
The Village Bell-Ringer token enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {R}.
The Village Bell-Ringer token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
